title: Recruitment for various posts on Deputation/Absorption basis
organization: Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Chandigarh
age_limit: Maximum 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of application
summary: The Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Chandigarh, invites applications for 57 various ministerial and technical posts on a deputation/absorption basis for a period of three years. Eligible candidates from Central or State Government departments, Tribunals, or Courts may apply by submitting the prescribed pro-forma along with required documents.
eligibility_bullets: Candidates must be currently working in Central/State Government, Tribunals, or Courts.
Must hold analogous posts or meet specific service/pay level requirements as per the post.
Maximum age limit is 56 years as of the application deadline.
Specific educational qualifications (10th, 12th, or Degree) and skill tests apply depending on the post.
Candidates must have a clean vigilance record and provide ACRs for the last five years.
how_to_apply_steps: Download the application pro-forma (Annexure-1) from the official website.
Fill in the required details and attach necessary educational and experience certificates.
Ensure the application is forwarded through the proper channel by the parent department.
Include photocopies of Annual Confidential Reports (ACRs) for the last five years and a Vigilance Clearance Certificate.
Send the completed application to the Registrar, Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Chandigarh, Near Tank TCP, Chandimandir, Haryana-134107 by the deadline.
pay_level: Pay Matrix Level 1 To Level 11 (7th CPC)
